mechanics.title: Layered bars
mechanics.description: Health above ten hearts and armor above vanilla limits are drawn as layers using the vanilla color for the base and a single highlight color for extra layers, with a numeric layer counter.

mechanics.title: Toughness bar
mechanics.description: A dedicated armor toughness bar is added to the HUD.

mechanics.title: Chat fix
mechanics.description: Chat messages no longer cover armor-related HUD elements.

qol: Compact HUD with very high health or armor values
Layout, counters and stacking behavior are configurable
editor_notes: The page recommends AttributeFix for armor/toughness above vanilla caps; it is not in this batch, so it may not be in the pack. Config in config/overflowingbars-client.toml.
name: Overflowing Bars
summary: Stacks health, armor and armor toughness into compact layered bars instead of adding extra rows, with a counter showing how many layers you have. It also adds an armor toughness bar to the HUD.
